newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate rises 60 bps to 12.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate rises 60 bps to 12.1 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate rose 60 basis points to 12.1 percent on Monday.
Some 20.3 million kuna were fresh borrowings, with call money loans steady at 11 percent. Interbank term rates ranged between 12 and 15 percent.
Insurers rolled over one-week loans at 10 percent.
The central bank's kuna mid-rates for Tuesday eased to 5.8351 against the dollar and to 3.5654 to the German mark. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
